narr: On July 9th, a weak disturbance, followed by a cold front, resulted in rounds of showers and thunderstorms throughout the day. One early morning storm produced a lightning strike that caused an apartment fire in Putnam County. The majority of the three story building was gutted. Numerous showers and storms then developed in the afternoon, resulting in flash flooding in Fayette County. A few downed trees also occurred.
ev: A foot and a half of water was observed across Cannelton Road in Smithers. Flooding also occurred along Deepwater Mountain Road and other local roads in Montgomery.
lsr: Montgomery Fire Department reported about a foot and a half of water across Cennelton Road in Smithers, and flooding of Deep Water Mountain Road and other roads in Montgomery.
